name: 5882-synth256-7b-8gpu
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1, single-node multiprocessing executor (one worker process per rank, no Ray); declared only at TP=8.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 320 streams, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 8000 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, request_format plain, fixed lengths: every request is exactly 256 prompt tokens and exactly 256 output tokens, sampled at temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0.
purpose: A seven-billion-parameter chat assistant serving 320 concurrent users short uniform prompts and replies across eight GPUs.
launch:
# This engine is from 2024-06 and its `AsyncEngineArgs` is small: an unknown key is a TypeError
# at engine construction. Do not add keys from a later vLLM (compilation config, cudagraph
# capture sizes, structured-output backends, kv-connectors do not exist here).
model: NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-hf
tensor-parallel-size: 8
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
distributed-executor-backend: mp
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-batched-tokens: 4096
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
dtype: float16
enforce-eager: false
seed: 0
